notes: Implemented staged fallback mapping pipeline for env/out variables in both realtime ingestion scripts: exact lookup -> resolver -> optional constrained LLM fallback -> semantic fallback -> generic keyword -> unresolved. Added queueing safeguards and unit tests for fallback behavior.
issues_found: With LLM fallback disabled (default), semantic fallback alone recovers only a small fraction of unresolved rows in current corpus; high unresolved rates remain largely driven by off-domain/noisy terms.
LLM fallback requires explicit runtime enablement (`AE_ENABLE_LLM_FALLBACK`) and API credentials (`OPENAI_API_KEY`).
changes_to_plan: Proceed to P8.6 metrics instrumentation to monitor new match-type distribution including `llm_lookup_fallback` and `semantic_lookup_fallback`.
Prioritize domain-gating and unresolved-term cleanup for larger unresolved-rate reduction beyond fallback policy changes.
